implementation.summary: D27 adds a candidate-bound real local ML HTTP journey through Lab creation, quality, durable training, artifact registration, digest-verified retrieval, prediction, workspace denial and SQLite restart recovery. The runtime already provided the path; the missing evidence was made reproducible without mocks.

security_and_recovery.workspace_scope: The real local composition returns HTTP 403 for the registered model card from an unknown workspace; all exercised ML routes use the configured bearer token and workspace scope.
security_and_recovery.ml_journey: A real SQLite catalog revision is bound to a Lab digest; quality passes before durable training; the local.sklearn decision-tree execution completes asynchronously; registration rechecks the artifact identity; the model card preserves dataset and source Lab digest; chunked artifact retrieval returns the registered digest; prediction is deterministic; the model card and prediction survive composition restart.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the real local.sklearn provider and local SQLite/ArtifactStore composition were exercised. PostgreSQL ML stores, S3-compatible artifact qualification, MLflow/interoperability, network serving and external provider certification were not run and are not claimed.

The candidate archive intentionally does not package browser dependencies; the checkout browser run is separate UI-contract evidence.
